en.summary: Fixes FPU conversion decode semantics, especially the RV64 W-versus-L distinction for FCVT operations. The decoder now takes integer-width selection from rs2[1] instead of overloading the FP format field, and the simulator and trace logic are updated to match.
why_it_counts: The patch changes the RTL decoder in a way that directly alters executed instruction semantics.
The updated simulator and trace code match the same decode bug rather than introducing a new feature.
The affected instructions are architectural FCVT variants, not debug-only paths.
disqualifiers: The commit also touches trace and test infrastructure, but those changes are secondary mirrors of the decode fix.
evidence: VX_decode.sv changes op_args.fpu.fmt[1] for FCVT instructions from funct2-based encoding to rs2[1], with an inline comment 'CVT W/L'.
VX_trace_pkg.sv rewrites FCVT mnemonic selection to decode all four W/WU/L/LU combinations explicitly.
sim/simx/types.h renames the simulator-side field from fmt to cvt, and sim/simx/execute.cpp uses cvt rather than fmt to pick FCVT operation width.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Floating-point conversion decode needs two independent pieces of information: floating-point precision and integer destination or source width. If a decoder reuses one bitfield for both roles, an RV64-class design can interpret 64-bit FCVT instructions as 32-bit variants or vice versa. The arithmetic engine then executes the wrong architectural conversion even though the opcode class is otherwise correct.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The core executes FCVT.W, FCVT.WU, FCVT.L, FCVT.LU, FCVT.S.W, FCVT.S.L, or their double-precision counterparts on a design that supports both 32-bit and 64-bit integer widths.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Decode the integer-width selector from the floating-point format field instead of from the dedicated conversion-width field.
portability_notes: Map this to any decoder that must distinguish FP precision from integer width for conversion instructions.
The bug is purely architectural decode selection, so it is portable across RTL and simulator DUTs.
Do not alter the convert unit itself; only corrupt the field that tells it whether to perform W or L conversion.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the decode logic that produces control bits for FP-to-int and int-to-FP conversion instructions.
Make the width-select control reuse a floating-point format bit or another unrelated field instead of the dedicated W/L selector.
Leave the main opcode and sign/unsigned selection unchanged so only the 32-bit versus 64-bit conversion choice regresses.
Mirror the same mistake in any tightly coupled reference model only if the target DUT is a simulator rather than RTL.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: FCVT decode field selection for W/L conversion width
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changed RTL FCVT decoding to take the width bit from rs2[1], and updated trace and simulator code to use a dedicated conversion-width field instead of overloading fmt.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_decode.sv, restore op_args.fpu.fmt[1] for FCVT from the old funct2-based source instead of rs2[1], and if needed mirror the same misuse in sim/simx/execute.cpp and sim/simx/types.h.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: RV64 FCVT instructions execute the wrong 32-bit or 64-bit conversion variant, producing incorrect result width, sign extension, and architectural mnemonic behavior.
evidence_for_injection: The decode fix is a one-bit control-source change with direct architectural effect.
Trace and simulator changes were updated in lockstep, confirming the original bug was semantic rather than cosmetic.
The affected instruction family is precisely FCVT W/WU/L/LU and their inverse forms.
notes: This is a clean decode-only fault and is highly portable.
Tests that distinguish FCVT.W from FCVT.L are the best validation pattern.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 FPU conversion 的 decode 语义，尤其是 RV64 中 FCVT 的 W 与 L 区分。现在 decoder 会从 rs2[1] 获取整数位宽选择，而不是错误地复用浮点格式字段，模拟器和 trace 也同步修正了这一点。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是 RTL decoder，而且会直接改变实际执行的指令语义。
同步更新的模拟器和 trace 代码是在配合同一个 decode bug，而不是新增功能。
受影响的是体系结构层面的 FCVT 指令，而不是仅供调试使用的路径。
disqualifiers: 该提交也触及 trace 与测试基础设施，但那些改动只是 decode 修复的镜像更新。
evidence: VX_decode.sv 把 FCVT 指令的 op_args.fpu.fmt[1] 从基于 funct2 的编码改成了 rs2[1]，并附带注释 'CVT W/L'。
VX_trace_pkg.sv 重写了 FCVT 助记符选择逻辑，显式区分四种 W/WU/L/LU 组合。
sim/simx/types.h 把模拟器侧字段从 fmt 改名为 cvt，sim/simx/execute.cpp 也开始根据 cvt 而不是 fmt 来选择 FCVT 的位宽。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 浮点转换指令的 decode 需要两类相互独立的信息：浮点精度，以及整数源或目的操作数的位宽。如果 decoder 把同一个 bitfield 同时拿来表示这两件事，那么在支持 32 位和 64 位整数宽度的设计里，RV64 类 FCVT 指令就会把 64 位版本误当成 32 位版本，或者反过来。这样即使 opcode 类别没错，算术引擎执行的也是错误的体系结构转换。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 内核执行 FCVT.W、FCVT.WU、FCVT.L、FCVT.LU、FCVT.S.W、FCVT.S.L 及其双精度对应形式，而且设计同时支持 32 位与 64 位整数宽度。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让整数位宽选择重新从浮点格式字段获取，而不是从专用的 conversion-width 字段获取。
portability_notes: 可映射到任何需要同时区分浮点精度和整数位宽的转换指令 decoder。
该缺陷是纯粹的体系结构 decode 选择错误，因此适用于 RTL 与 simulator DUT。
不要修改 convert 单元本身，只破坏告诉它应该执行 W 还是 L 转换的控制字段。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到为 FP-to-int 和 int-to-FP conversion 指令生成控制位的 decode 逻辑。
让位宽选择控制重新复用浮点格式位，或其它无关字段，而不是专用的 W/L 选择字段。
保持主 opcode 以及 signed/unsigned 选择不变，只让 32 位和 64 位转换的选择退化。
如果目标 DUT 是模拟器而不是 RTL，则只在紧耦合参考模型里同步引入同样的字段误用。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: FCVT 指令 W/L 转换位宽的解码字段选择
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 RTL 中 FCVT 的位宽位改为取自 rs2[1]，并同步更新 trace 与 simulator，使它们使用专门的 conversion-width 字段，而不再复用 fmt。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_decode.sv 中把 FCVT 的 op_args.fpu.fmt[1] 恢复成旧的 funct2 来源而不是 rs2[1]；如果需要，也可在 sim/simx/execute.cpp 与 sim/simx/types.h 中恢复同样的字段误用。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: RV64 的 FCVT 指令会执行错误的 32 位或 64 位转换变体，产生错误的结果位宽、符号扩展和体系结构可见行为。
evidence_for_injection: 这个 decode 修复本质上是一位控制源的改变，且直接影响体系结构行为。
trace 与模拟器代码同步更新，证明原始问题是语义错误而不是显示问题。
受影响的指令族正是 FCVT 的 W/WU/L/LU 以及它们的反向形式。
notes: 这是一个非常干净的 decode 类故障，移植性很高。
能区分 FCVT.W 和 FCVT.L 的测试是最佳验证方式。
